claims.claim: Dandy's World was created on January 26, 2024, by the BlushCrunch Studio group.
claims.notes: Read from Roblox's public games API on Nov 23, 2026: created 2024-01-26T03:52:09Z, creator BlushCrunch Studio (Group, verified badge), max 35 players per server.

claims.claim: 8,049,368,573 total visits, 143,474 playing, 5,059,783 favorites, read from Roblox's public games API on November 23, 2026.
claims.notes: API read Nov 23, 2026 ~23:00 UTC. Name on Roblox: 'Dandy's World [1.0]'.

claims.claim: Dandy's World ranked #6 on the most-played list with 143,680 playing at 22:53 UTC, November 23, 2026; 24-hour peak 172,295.
claims.notes: livecounts.nl, from Roblox's own Top Playing Now list, crawled 22:56 UTC Nov 23, 2026.

claims.claim: Recorded peak 797,183 concurrent players on November 20, 2026 — the day version 1.0 launched.
claims.notes: livecounts.nl 'Highest player counts we recorded', tracking since Sep 23, 2026; 797,183 is the highest count recorded for the game in that window, dated Nov 20, 2026.

claims.claim: Dandy's World ranked #1 on the trending-by-growth chart with 144,000 playing and 89% likes, November 23, 2026.
claims.notes: rblxstat.com trending list, read Nov 23, 2026 ~23:00 UTC. Ranked by growth in player count over the last week.

claims.claim: Version 1.0 arrived on November 20, 2026: The Labs, a new game mode with 11 floors; 2 new OA Toons, Dessa and Dioda; a new premium Rainbow-Time Bundle; thousands of lines of new lore and dialogue.
claims.notes: From the official game description, read via the Roblox public games API on Nov 23, 2026. Gaming Route confirmed the same four lines on Nov 20, 2026, 22:32 UTC.

claims.claim: Version 1.0 adds more than 130 collectible Lab Cards and a new currency, Ambrosia; nothing players earned in two years of alpha was reset.
claims.notes: tml.news, Nov 2026; mmodude reports the same (130+ Lab Cards, Ambrosia, no reset).

claims.claim: The game loop, from the official game description: team up with fellow Toons to complete machines and descend deeper into Gardenview Center.
claims.notes: Official description, read via the Roblox public games API on Nov 23, 2026.

claims.claim: The Twisteds are the scary versions of the same mascots, and they hunt you on every floor.
claims.notes: mobilegamesguide.com Dandy's World guide, checked Nov 23, 2026.

claims.claim: The game was created on January 26, 2024, and its Alpha release was June 14, 2024 — version 1.0 arrived November 20, 2026, after more than two years in alpha.
claims.notes: Dandy's World (Game) wiki: 'created on January 26, 2024, but wasn't publicly available to players until its Alpha release on June 14, 2024.' 1.0 date from the official game description.
